title: Governed Business Build Execution Activation Contract

taskContracts.objective: Define P82 live-readiness activation contracts and inventory without enabling runtime execution.

inputs.narrowScope: Add P82 live-ready activation contracts, activation boundary docs, checker, roadmap/status entries, and generated evidence only.
safetyRules: Do not enable provider calls, tool execution, worker execution, project mutation, DB writes, network calls, deploy, release, export, package creation, auth/session/user/workspace mutation, or provider spend. Require approval, scope, budget, rollback, activity evidence, cost evidence, redaction checks, and validation before later live activation.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse shared report writers, result envelopes, mode guards, redaction, checker formatters, phase status updater, route matrices, and existing readiness helpers; do not duplicate helpers.

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Later P82 UX must replace stale Preview labels with Ready, Needs setup, or Blocked by policy only when supported by current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner, evidence, activity, and cost impact.
themeRequirements: Preserve System, Dark, and Light themes.
playwrightTests: No Playwright route change unless Command Center UX changes in this subphase.
checkerUpdates: Register package script, allow P82.1-P82.7 in OS phase status checker, and preserve P81 final validation once P82 starts.
docsRoadmap: Update P82 plan, platform roadmap, OS roadmap, phase status, and generated reports.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P82 in_progress, mark P82.1 complete, and set nextPhase to P82.2.

dataShapes: phaseId, scopeClassification, liveReadinessInventory, activationGates, validationCommands, nextPhase

finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no stale Preview labels are reclassified without evidence.
gitCommands: git commit -m "docs(nexus): add live ready activation contracts"

acceptanceCriteria: P82 has implementation-grade contracts for seven subphases.
P82.1 does not enable live runtime execution.

taskContracts.objective: Replace stale preview labels with evidence-backed live-readiness labels in Command Center.

inputs.narrowScope: Add Command Center live-ready activation UX and Playwright coverage only.
safetyRules: Do not expose runnable provider, tool, worker, project mutation, DB, deploy, release, export, package, auth, or spend actions. Require approval, scope, budget/cost posture, rollback, activity evidence, cost evidence, redaction checks, and validation before any Ready label can imply live activation.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse existing Command Center routes, tabs, cards, badges, evidence/activity/cost patterns, and check helpers; do not duplicate helpers.

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Show Ready, Needs setup, or Blocked by policy with current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner, evidence, activity, and cost impact. Do not show raw JSON, logs, DemoApp, raw private IDs, or fake runnable actions.
playwrightTests: Preserve no DemoApp leakage, no raw dumps, theme switcher, sidebar navigation, OS Roadmap separation, and project milestone separation tests.
checkerUpdates: Register package script and update route-wide safety coverage.
docsRoadmap: Update P82 docs, roadmap, status, and reports.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P82.6 complete and set nextPhase to P82.7.

dataShapes: currentState, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceLocation, activityLocation, costImpact, readinessRows

validationCommands: cd dashboard && npx playwright test tests/routes.spec.js --grep "Live Ready"
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm stale Preview labels are not blindly renamed.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): add command center live ready ux"

acceptanceCriteria: Command Center labels are live-readiness accurate.
Primary UX has no DemoApp, raw dumps, private IDs, or fake runnable actions.

taskContracts.objective: Close P82 after validating live-readiness activation remains governed and evidence-backed.

inputs.narrowScope: Add final validation checker/report and close P82 status only.
safetyRules: Do not enable any runtime execution surface without explicit later activation gates. Require approval, scope, budget/cost posture, rollback, activity evidence, cost evidence, redaction checks, and validation before P82 can mark a surface Ready.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse shared report, checker, redaction, phase status, and Command Center helpers; do not duplicate helpers.

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve live-ready Command Center UX with accurate labels, current state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner, evidence, activity, cost impact, and no fake actions.
themeRequirements: Preserve System, Dark, and Light themes.
checkerUpdates: Register package script and keep route-wide safety checks current.
docsRoadmap: Update P82 docs, roadmap, phase status, and reports.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P82 complete after validation and set nextPhase to P83.

dataShapes: phaseStatus, readinessRows, commandCenterCoverage, checksRun, knownLimitations, nextPhase

validationCommands: cd dashboard && npx playwright test tests/routes.spec.js --grep "Live Ready"
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm no unsafe runtime action is exposed.
Confirm next phase remains planned only.
gitCommands: git commit -m "test(nexus): close live ready activation validation"

acceptanceCriteria: P82 validates live-readiness posture end to end.
Unsafe runtime execution remains blocked until explicitly enabled by future gated implementation.
